name: Eladrin
description: Eladrin are elves of the Feywild, a realm of perilous beauty and boundless magic. Using that magic, eladrin can step from one place to another in the blink of an eye, and each eladrin resonates with emotions captured in the Feywild in the form of seasons — affinities that affect the eladrin's mood and appearance. An eladrin's season can change, though some remain in one season forever. Choose your season or roll on the Eladrin Seasons table. Your Trance trait lets you change your season. Like other elves, eladrin can live to be over 750 years old.

features.name: Age
features.description: Like other elves, eladrin can live to be over 750 years old.
features.snippet: Eladrin can live to be over 750 years old.

features.name: Size
features.description: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
features.snippet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves do not need to sleep. Instead, they enter a meditation known as "trance." Instead of the normal 6-8 hours a human requires, elves need to only trance for 4 hours a day. However, the duration of a long rest does not change. During a rest, you may enter a Trance to take an additional rest move so long as you are not interrupted. Your Trance trait lets you change your season.
features.snippet: You trance for 4 hours instead of sleeping. Your Trance lets you change your season.

features.name: Step of Seasons
features.description:
As a Minor Action, you can take a Stress to magically teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see. Depending on your season, you may take another Stress to gain an additional effect; if the effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this race):
- **Autumn.** Immediately after you use your Fey Step, up to two creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Will saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute, or until you or your companions deal any damage to the creatures.
- **Winter.** When you use your Fey Step, one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you before you teleport must succeed on a Reflex saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
- **Spring.** When you use your Fey Step, you can touch one willing creature within 5 ft. of you. That creature then teleports to the space instead of you with a shimmering shield of leaves, gaining 1d4 + your proficiency bonus temporary hit points.
- **Summer.** Immediately after you use your Fey Step, each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you must make a Fortitude saving throw or be set on fire for 1 minute, taking fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of its turn. A burning creature may end the effect as an action on its turn, submerging itself in water, or taking cold damage.
features.snippet: As a Minor Action, take a Stress to teleport up to 30 ft. You may take another Stress for a season-based effect (Autumn/Winter/Spring/Summer).

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
features.snippet: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
